project.snap.title: Snap To Table - AI Recipe Generator
project.snap.description:
A full-stack web application that uses AI to recognize
ingredients from a user-uploaded photo and generate custom recipes. I developed
the complete solution, from the .NET backend processing images and interacting
with the AI model, to the responsive React Native frontend providing a seamless
user experience.
